subStrands.name: Meaning, History, Contracts, Risk, Hazards, Functions and Perils

objectives.description: Meaning of insurance; historical development — pre and post independence era and legislations.
Insurance contracts: parties to insurance contract; essential features of insurance contract.
Risks: meaning; effect of risks on the society; classification of risks; insurable and un-insurable risk.
Hazards: meaning; types.
Functions of insurance: primary functions; secondary functions; benefits of insurance.
Perils: meaning; differences among perils, risks and hazards.
Insurable Interest: meaning; essential features; application in life assurance and property insurance.
Utmost Good Faith: meaning; insured and insurer's duty of disclosure; breaches and effects.
Proximate Cause: meaning; application of proximate cause on claims.
Indemnity: meaning; methods of providing indemnity by insurer; application in property and liability insurance.
Subrogation: meaning; insurer's right under subrogation; insured's duty under subrogation.
Contribution: meaning; application; conditions necessary for contribution.

subStrands.name: Proposal Forms, Cover Notes, Certificates and Policy

objectives.description: Proposal Forms: meaning; functions and uses; contracts where proposal forms are used.
Cover Notes: meaning; contents; functions and uses; contracts where cover notes are issued.
Certificate of Insurance: meaning; certificate of insurance in motor, marine, and employer's liability.
Policy: meaning; component parts of a policy; parties to a policy.
Re-insurance: meaning; forms (facultative and treaty); functions; uses.
Insurance Renewals: meaning of renewal notice; renewal procedure; legal status of renewal notice; no claim discount (NCD); long term agreement (LTA).

Insurance Claims: meaning; claim procedure — notification, documentation, investigation, discharge voucher, payment; duties of the insured and the underwriter in claims; functions of loss assessors and loss adjusters.
Insurance Premium: meaning; factors to be considered when determining a premium; factors responsible for loading premium; return premium — partial and full return.

Motor Insurance: meaning; types of policies (private car, commercial vehicle, motorcycle, agricultural and forestry vehicle, special types); scope of cover — act only, third party only, third party fire and theft, comprehensive; ECOWAS Brown Card.
Fire Insurance: meaning; standard fire policy cover; special perils (earthquake, flood, riot and strike); properties covered; buyers of fire insurance.
Theft Insurance and Burglary Insurance: meaning; properties covered; coverage in business and private premises; differences between theft insurance and burglary insurance.
Money Insurance: meaning; what constitutes money (cash, cheque, postal order); types of cover — in transit only, in safe after business hours, in custody of a staff.
Fidelity Guarantee Insurance: meaning; types of policies (named, position, blanket); bond meaning.
Engineering Insurance; Marine Insurance; Aviation Insurance: meaning, types of policies, risks covered, international regulations.
Employer's Liability Insurance: meaning; policy covered (employees compensation policy); level of benefits; perils covered.
Public Liability Insurance: meaning; types (personal liability policy, product liability policy).
Professional Indemnity: meaning; professionals that require professional indemnity (doctors, lawyers, insurance brokers, accountants, architects).
Business Interruption Insurance (Consequential Loss): meaning; causes of business interruption.
Personal Accident Insurance: meaning; risks covered (death, bodily injury, permanent disability, total temporary disability, medical expenses); forms (personal and group); benefits.

Insurance Market Operators: meaning; market operators — insurance companies, reinsurance companies, insurance intermediaries (brokers and agents), insurance buyers (individual and corporate), insurance sellers, supporting services (assessors and loss adjusters).

Insurance Regulators: Nigerian Insurance Association (NIA); Nigerian Council of Registered Insurance Brokers (NCRIB); Institute of Loss Adjusters of Nigeria (ILAN); National Insurance Commission (NAICOM); Chartered Insurance Institute of Nigeria (CIIN) — meaning, role/functions, purpose, membership.

Common Insurance Terminologies: hazards, perils, concealment, disclosure, days of grace, ex-gratia payment, extra-premium, endorsement, excepted perils, subject matter of insurance, under insurance, return premium, surrender value, cover note.
